name: Mid-run steering (both stances)
prose: typing while a turn runs sends `steer_message`: the text joins the running turn at its next message boundary, re-arms self-verify, refunds pivots; when the turn already ended, it becomes a normal user turn. Slash/bang commands still queue for turn end.
invariant: steer_message joins a running turn at its next message boundary, re-arms self-verify and refunds pivots; when idle it becomes a normal user turn.
